patterns.note: Content sections alternate between full-width light backgrounds and full-width dark backgrounds, creating clear visual separation and rhythm.
Primary headings use a very light-weight, wide sans-serif font with generous letter spacing, creating an elegant and spacious feel, contrasted with a more standard sans-serif for body text.
A high-contrast palette of near-black and white is consistently used for backgrounds and text, with a vibrant orange serving as the primary accent for calls to action.

The hero section dynamically transforms on scroll: the large 'Rebalance the planet' text and the central circular graphic shrink and move upwards, while the navigation bar simultaneously transitions to a sticky, compact state at the top.
Testimonial sections feature a horizontal carousel of client quotes, each with a photo and name, providing social proof in an easily digestible format.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a scroll-triggered animation (likely GSAP ScrollTrigger) to scale down and reposition the main title and a unique circular graphic, while simultaneously shrinking and fixing the navigation bar to the top of the viewport.
Content sections below the hero are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement as the user scrolls.
A circular element within the hero features text that continuously rotates around its perimeter, likely achieved using CSS keyframes or a similar animation library.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, thin, wide-letter-spaced hero headings (~4-5x body) with small, regular-weight body text and very small, uppercase labels for context.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, input fields, and card corners have a slight, consistent curve).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, becoming more balanced in content grids.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dynamic hero section, where the main title and a unique circular graphic perform a sophisticated shrinking and repositioning animation on scroll, creating an immediate sense of modern interactivity and brand identity.
